stem: Which approach to antibiotic prophylaxis for dental patients at risk for infection is consistent with AAPD guidance?

options.text: Give prophylaxis routinely to every patient with SHCN regardless of individual circumstances.
For a patient with compromised immunity, decide on management without involving the physician.
Withhold prophylaxis even from patients at high risk of adverse outcomes who undergo invasive procedures.
Decide on prophylaxis individually for each patient, recommending it for high-risk patients undergoing invasive procedures.
